q1: SELECT CLASS FROM COURSES GROUP BY CLASS HAVING COUNT(*)>=5
q2: SELECT CLASS FROM ( SELECT CLASS, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT) NUM FROM COURSES GROUP BY CLASS HAVING NUM >= 5 ) AS A
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT CLASS FROM COURSES GROUP BY CLASS HAVING COUNT(*)>=5
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT CLASS FROM ( SELECT CLASS, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT) NUM FROM COURSES GROUP BY CLASS HAVING NUM >= 5 ) AS A
explanation: Q1 counts all rows per class (including duplicates) and returns classes with at least 5 rows. Q2 counts distinct students per class and returns classes with at least 5 distinct students. They differ when a class has repeated entries for the same student.
counterexample_dsp: A class with 5 rows but only 4 distinct students will be excluded by Q2 but included by Q1.
